title: Unique identifier linking health data to user
description: The companion app processes calorie, meal, and weight entries linked to a unique user identifier (account ID), enabling linking of all health data to a specific individual.
assumptions: User authentication is required to log entries in the app

title: Profiling through health data patterns
description: The app can analyze patterns in calorie intake, meal choices, and weight changes to create a detailed profile of the user's health behaviors and characteristics.
assumptions: App stores and processes historical health data entries

title: Processing of identified health data
description: The companion app processes health data (calories, meals, weight) that is explicitly identified and linked to a specific user account.
assumptions: User must be logged in to submit health entries

title: Revealing health attributes
description: Weight, calorie intake, and meal data are revealing attributes that could support identification of the data subject, especially when combined with other data.
assumptions: Health data can be distinctive enough to identify individuals

title: Attributable health data entries
description: Logged calorie, meal, and weight entries can be attributed to the user, preventing them from denying they made these specific health data submissions.
assumptions: App maintains audit trail of user entries with timestamps

title: Sensitive health data collection
description: Weight, calorie intake, and meal data are sensitive health-related personal data types that require careful handling and justification for collection.
assumptions: Health data is considered sensitive under privacy regulations

title: Fine-grained health data granularity
description: Detailed meal entries and precise calorie counts may be more granular than functionally necessary for the app's core functionality.
assumptions: App requires detailed meal logging rather than summary data
uncertainty_note: Depends on app's stated purpose and functionality

title: Analysis and enrichment of health data
description: The app may analyze, enrich, or derive additional insights from health data beyond what is necessary for basic logging functionality.
assumptions: App performs analytics on collected health data
uncertainty_note: Uncertain extent of data analysis performed

title: Unawareness of health data processing
description: Users may not be fully aware of how their health data (calories, meals, weight) is processed, stored, or potentially shared beyond the app.
assumptions: Privacy policy may not clearly explain all data processing activities
uncertainty_note: Depends on app's transparency and privacy communications

title: Limited control over health data rectification/erasure
description: Users may lack adequate controls to correct inaccurate health entries or delete their health data from the system.
assumptions: App may not provide comprehensive data management features
uncertainty_note: Depends on app's data management capabilities

title: Potential violation of data minimization
description: Collection of detailed health data (calories, meals, weight) may exceed what is minimally necessary for the app's stated functionality.
assumptions: App collects more health data than strictly required
uncertainty_note: Depends on app's functional requirements and data collection practices

title: Health profiling through cross-session analysis
description: The Health Analytics Service analyzes calorie, weight, and exercise logs across multiple sessions to perform health-condition analysis. This enables profiling of individuals based on their health data patterns, linking data points to create comprehensive health profiles.
assumptions: Health logs contain sufficient data points across sessions to enable meaningful profiling

title: Quasi-identifier identification through health data patterns
description: Health data (calorie intake, weight, exercise patterns) across sessions can serve as quasi-identifiers that may uniquely identify individuals, especially when combined with temporal patterns.
assumptions: Health data patterns are sufficiently unique to individuals

title: Sensitive health data collection
description: Health logs containing calorie, weight, and exercise data are highly sensitive personal data types. Processing this data requires strict necessity justification.
assumptions: Health data is classified as sensitive personal data under applicable regulations

title: Excessive volume of health data processing
description: Reading health logs 'across sessions' suggests processing potentially excessive amounts of historical health data beyond what may be functionally needed for health-condition analysis.
assumptions: Not all historical session data is necessary for the analytics purpose
uncertainty_note: Uncertainty about what volume is actually functionally required

title: Unnecessary data enrichment through analytics

assumptions: Health-condition analysis involves data enrichment beyond basic processing

title: Unawareness of cross-session health data processing

title: Attributable health behavior evidence

assumptions: Health data includes sensitive personal information about individuals' medical conditions, treatments, and health status.

assumptions: The full dataset includes all historical and current health/location data rather than aggregated or anonymized analytics results.

title: Limited control over data rectification and erasure
